This avian beast tribe resides on the floating islands dotting the Sea of Clouds, characterized by brightly colored plumage and a communal, celebratory culture centered on their primal deity, Bismarck.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Vanu gain +2 Constitution, +2 Wisdom, and -2 Intelligence.
  • Size: Vanu are Medium creatures.
  • Type: Vanu are Humanoid creatures with the vanu subtype.
  • Base Speed: Vanu have a base speed of 30 feet.
  • Languages: Vanu start off with Common and Vanu. They can learn any of the beastmen languages.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Desert Runner: Vanu receive a +4 racial bonus on Constitution checks and Fortitude saves to avoid fatigue and exhaustion.
  • Elemental's Gift: Once per day, a vanu can grant himself a +2 deflection bonus to AC against ranged attacks for 1 minute.
  • Heightened Elemental Resistance: Vanu gain wind resistance 10.
  • Sleepless Magicks: Vanu are immune to magic sleep effects and gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against enfeebling spells and effects.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Gift of Tongues: Vanu gain a +1 racial bonus on Bluff and Diplomacy checks, and learn one additional language every rank in Linguistics.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Sky Sentinel: Vanu gain a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls, a +2 dodge bonus to AC, and a +2 bonus on Perception checks against flying creatures. Enemies on higher ground gain no attack bonus against vanu.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Low-Light Vision: Vanu have low-light vision, allowing them to see twice as far as humes in dim light.
